seoTitle: Gérard & Fils - National removals throughout Belgium
seoDesc: We take care of your move from A to Z anywhere in Belgium, whether you are a private individual or a business. Request your free quote.

body.p: Are you leaving your flat in Brussels to settle in a house in Wallonia or Flanders? Or moving to the capital for work or personal reasons? We handle your entire move within Belgium, on the date of your choice and in line with all your requirements. Trust our removers to transport your belongings safely across the whole country. We take care of packing your personal effects and dismantling your furniture, and we protect everything so that you can settle into your new home with complete peace of mind. Our expertise guarantees an impeccable service down to the last detail, with no surprises and no hitches.
Our removers carry out the following services with care and attention to detail:

ul: Packing and protection of your belongings
Furniture lift hire for moving heavy and bulky items
Cleaning of the premises before and after the move

sections.h: Our strengths for a hassle-free national move

body.p: We always make sure we meet your needs and keep precisely to your budget. Our family business, approved by the Belgian Chamber of Removers (CBD), will take the greatest care of your belongings. Whether you are planning a move in the lively centre of Brussels or in a more residential setting, Gérard & Fils always adapts its organisation. In Watermael-Boitsfort, for example, our teams are used to handling a variety of situations: family homes with plenty of furniture, upper-floor flats requiring a lift, or narrower roads that call for precise truck logistics. This expertise allows us to guarantee a smooth service in which every detail is anticipated to avoid stress and unexpected problems.

body.box: A free quote and competitive rates

body.p: Our Brussels-based company travels throughout the capital, as well as in Wallonia and Flanders. Whatever the distance, the volume to be moved or the need for a furniture lift, you can count on us for an offer that meets all your expectations. Need an approved removal company in Schaerbeek or another municipality? Request your free, personalised quote.

Our removers also work regularly in Woluwe-Saint-Lambert, a municipality that combines residential neighbourhoods, major roads and modern buildings. Here too, we know how to adapt our equipment and timing: planning the use of a lift, organising the loading of the truck or handling parking permits. Thanks to this know-how, you benefit from a practical, quick and secure move.
Call us for any further information about our wide range of services. You can also request a quote for your move by filling in our form.
